steps.title: Login screen — initial state

steps.title: Continue with password — password screen
steps.notes: Phone-number EditText has no content-desc/text of its own, so the '+91' country-code badge is used as the tap selector to focus it before typing. settleMs after the +91 tap avoids dropping the first typed character on this Compose field. Re-verified live 2026-08-05 (full 10-digit number '9355098542' landed correctly, password screen reached with all three assertions present).

steps.title: Successful login — Home page
steps.notes: Types directly into the password field, already focused on this screen (unique password="true" EditText attribute). Tap on 'Login' content-desc view submits. Re-verified live 2026-08-05: landed on Home page with 'FasTag' marker present within 0s of tap.
